isles.line_cn: 雪线化水，在高台上绕两个弯，越过断崖成瀑布，再绕过草甸流进湖里。鹿在河边低头吃草，入夜木屋亮起一扇窗。
isles.line: Meltwater leaves the snowline, winds across a plateau, drops over a cliff as a waterfall and reaches a lake. Deer graze by the river; at night one cabin window comes on.
isles.wonder: This isle has no wonder set.

isles.line_cn: 隆冬大雪。一座孤峰压在云底下，湖冻成一面镜子，岩阶上挂着冰瀑；牦牛排成一行走过雪原，石屋旁的经幡在风里抖。
isles.line: Deep winter, snow all day. A lone peak under low cloud, a lake frozen to a mirror, an icefall on the rock step; yaks cross the snowfield in single file and prayer flags shake beside a stone hut.
isles.wonder_cn: 一奇：入夜后，冻住的湖面下有发光的鱼在游。
isles.wonder: The wonder: after dark, glowing fish swim under the frozen lake.
